data.title: Four-legged robot solves giant Rubik's Cube without using hands
data.description: Researchers from ETH Zurich’s Robotic Systems Lab have taught one of its four-legged ANYmal robots to solve a giant Rubik's Cube using its feet.
data.author: Christopher McFadden
data.keywords: AI, AI and robotics, Inventions and Machines, robot solves giant Rubik's Cube
